decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 31 July 2022 Time 12:57 2022 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 28 - 31 July 2022 The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (Document 35), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The following Power Unit Elements have been used: 4th Internal Combustion Unit (ICE) 4th Turbo Charger (TC) 4th Motor Generator Unit – Heat (MGU-H) 4th Motor Generator Unit – Kinetic (MGU-K) 3rd Energy Store (ES) 3rd Control Electronics (CE) PU components were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc Ferme
offence: Breaches of Articles 28.2, 40.3 and 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: Having received a report from the Technical Delegate (Document 35) and having heard from the team representatives, we determined that the abovementioned changes to the Power Unit Components were made to the car. In addition, we determined that PU components were changed while the car was under Parc Ferme without the permission of the Technical Delegate, in breach of Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. The penalty for such a change is prescribed in 40.9 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and requires the car to start the race from the pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Summons Car 10 Pu Components
